about.title: Trey Able left private equity to found Able Industrial.
text: Before founding Able Industrial, Trey Able served as President of Infinity Investments, a private equity firm, from 2004 to 2009.
Today we are a general mechanical contractor focused on capital projects, turnarounds, mechanical rope access, specialty welding and vessel services.
We value relationships: our employees' well-being and safety is our highest priority, and we manage safety with a cloud-based system for incident reporting, behavioral based safety and training.
